question: What changed in the latest Laravel release that affects queue workers?

requiredElements.check: Identifies which release is the latest (v13.34.0 when written).
Mentions that jobs can count worker crashes towards maxExceptions (PR #61737).
Mentions that a job is notified when a timeout is going to occur (PR #61651).
Mentions that the JobProcessed event now includes the job duration (PR #61672).
Mentions that queue:restart displays an error when a worker is not restartable (PR #61706).

freshness: Written against v13.34.0 (published 2026-09-29). If a newer laravel/framework release exists at run time, the 'latest' is different and these elements no longer apply; the reviewer must score against that release's notes or mark the question stale.
flags: High staleness risk: Laravel can release weekly, so v13.34.0 may not be the latest when the baseline runs. Also, which of the v13.34.0 items count as 'affects queue workers' is a judgement call; I chose the four that change worker or job runtime behaviour and left out queue:flush --queue and Queue::isPaused() enum support. Please confirm or edit.
